scripts.dev: bun run build:frontend && bun manifest && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "bun --filter @jukebox/backend dev" "bun --filter @jukebox/frontend dev"
scripts.build: bun run build:frontend && bun manifest && bun --filter @jukebox/backend compile:embed
scripts.package: bun run build:frontend && bun manifest && bun ./scripts/package.ts
scripts.package:all: bun run build:frontend && bun manifest && bun ./scripts/package.ts --all
scripts.package:windows: bun run build:frontend && bun manifest && bun ./scripts/package.ts --target=windows
scripts.package:mac: bun run build:frontend && bun manifest && bun ./scripts/package.ts --target=mac
scripts.package:linux: bun run build:frontend && bun manifest && bun ./scripts/package.ts --target=linux
